a2_overfit_audit.note: val measures gold-vs-SYNTHETIC-corruption top-1 on held-out TRAINING tasks; the eval pool is real TRM candidates on the ARC-1 EVAL split — fully disjoint tasks (asserted at train time). A large val-vs-eval gap = distribution shift between synthetic corruptions and real generator errors, not task leak.

a3_no_oracle_audit: Energy computed from (demos, test_input, candidate_grid) only. The eval pool file does not contain gold output grids (exporter drops them); `correct` labels are used exclusively to score rankings post-hoc. Training corpus is arc-agi_training+concept; arc-agi_training2 was EXCLUDED after an overlap audit found 376/400 ARC-1 eval tasks inside it (29/30 pool tasks).

adversarial_verify.failure_attribution: RECIPE (synthetic-negative distribution + encoder resolution), not CONCEPT

corrigendum_2026_06_09_stage2.architecture_resolution_bottleneck: Global mean-pooled CNN cannot resolve 1-2-cell differences: on c3202e5a gold differs from the vote leader by ONE cell yet ranks 747/754 by E. Capacity exists where differences are coarse (f0df5ff0: gold ranked 1/212 above one-cell perturbations of it).
corrigendum_2026_06_09_stage2.complementarity_structurally_impossible: E's pass@2 hit-set is a STRICT SUBSET of vote's; on 4/5 vote-missed oracle entries >=2 wrong candidates Pareto-dominate gold in (votes,E), so NO monotone vote+E combination can exceed 0.4839 — the value the no-E union already reaches. Best steelman anywhere (dihedral-8 TTA-averaged E): pass@2 0.1935, AUROC 0.5852, CI95 vs vote still entirely below zero.
corrigendum_2026_06_09_stage2.hard_neg_auroc_caveat: hard-negatives AUROC 0.6181 rests on 90 pairs, per-task values quantized to {0,0.5,1}; the macro-vs-hard 'inversion' is statistically unsupported (paired sign test 8-vs-7, p~1.0; pair-weighted hard 0.5667 vs easy 0.5206).
corrigendum_2026_06_09_stage2.max_demos_truncation: MAX_DEMOS=4 truncated demos on 6/31 eval entries; verified metric-invariant (pass@2 identical at 0.1613 scoring with all demos).
corrigendum_2026_06_09_stage2.negative_distribution_gap: Only 72/1890 = 3.8% of TRM's real wrong candidates (28.2% by vote mass) are members of the 8 trained corruption families. 91.5% of real negatives share gold's SHAPE; the dominant classes are structured near-misses (29.7%, median Hamming 0.10) and plausible-but-wrong rule applications (59.1%) — neither represented in training. The EBM aces its curriculum on the real pool (lone identity-copy ranked dead last; gold-vs-demo-copy AUROC 0.833; size violators at E-pct 0.764) but is at/below chance on the untrained 96%: gold-vs-near-miss(<=5% cells) AUROC 0.481, gold-vs-same-shape-far 0.469, spearman(E, Hamming-to-gold)=0.04. The cleanest possible recipe-failure fingerprint.
corrigendum_2026_06_09_stage2.origin: 5-reviewer adversarial round (workflow gap3-stage2-adversarial-verify). Every committed number reproduced bit-for-bit from the shipped checkpoint. Corrections sharpen interpretation; headline verdict UNCHANGED.
corrigendum_2026_06_09_stage2.random_ranker_baseline: EBM pass@2 0.1613 (5/31) is statistically indistinguishable from a RANDOM ranker on this pool: exact Poisson-binomial expected pass@2 = 0.1432 (E[hits]=4.44, P(X>=5)=0.468). 'Weak but vote-orthogonal' should read 'approximately random at selection'. Vote's 14 hits: p=8.9e-9.
corrigendum_2026_06_09_stage2.tautological_asserts_fixed: The in-script no-oracle asserts were dead code (`assert X or True`); the property itself was independently verified (no gold grids in the pool; 12/31 entries contain no correct candidate). Fixed in-script same-day with a real key-whitelist + no-gold-grid scan.
corrigendum_2026_06_09_stage2.union_ci_gloss: union_plus_E_vs_union CI [0,0] means 0/31 top-2 candidate sets changed by adding E (decision-identical refits; E gets a right-signed +0.16 std-ized weight), not a measured confidence interval.
corrigendum_2026_06_09_stage2.val_headline_optimism: best_val_top1=0.5903 is a max over 17 noisy evals; mean-of-last-10 = 0.5333; fresh-negative re-measurement (seed 999, n=269) = 0.5204 +/- 0.0597 (~5.7x chance). Transfer-failure contrast stands.

honest_note: GAP-3 Stage 2. POSITIVE that survives the residual controls = a generator-independent content-aware energy reaches the present-but-mis-voted headroom -> register + re-confirm at 400 scale (grouped folds). NEGATIVE = even a trained content energy cannot beat vote on this pool; the remaining moves are training on real generator errors (forfeits strict generator-independence) or richer context encoding. Reported as-is per FALSE_NEGATIVE_RISK; the positive control holds (oracle > vote). CAVEAT n=31; CI upper edge governs; re-confirm at 400 before any irreversible claim.
